name: Kbd
description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut, like Ctrl or ⌘K, in a keycap style. Not interactive.

children.description: The key or keys, e.g. "Esc", "⌘" or "Ctrl". For a chord, use one Kbd per key.

requirements: Rendered with the kbd element, so assistive technology knows it is keyboard input
Symbols like ⌘ and ⌥ are not read consistently: write the key name in an aria-label or beside it when it matters
screenReader: Read as inline text, e.g. "Press Control K"

use_when: Hints inside menus, tooltips and the command palette
anti_patterns: Showing only Mac symbols to everyone
Relying on the shortcut being visible as the only way to find a feature
